<notes>
kept -> base -> base1 delivered correct answer (120, 1) with sound reasoning about Claire's timezone constraint; independent verification confirms Friday 14:00-16:00 is the only meeting time matching all constraints at hour/half-hour boundaries

dropped -> inv1 -> inv1 delivered (180, 1) but the reasoning contains a critical error: claims "C free [9:20-17:00)" in timezone T on Friday, but Claire works 9-5 in her local timezone (1 hour ahead), which is 8-4 (16:00) in timezone T; meeting 14:00-17:00 T would extend to 18:00 in Claire's local time, past her 17:00 (5pm) work limit. Harness unchanged from base, so variance is model stochasticity, not harness quality. Answer of 180 min contradicts the constraint directly.

dropped -> dom1 -> dom1 delivered (170, 2) using Python code, but the provided output truncates before showing script results; actual python execution details are missing so the answer cannot be verified. The code checks claire_end > 17*60 which correctly enforces the 17:00 limit in her local time (= 16:00 in T), which should reject any meeting beyond 14:00-16:00. Answer contradicts the verifiable 120-minute window. Harness unchanged from base.

base correctness -> Friday 14:00-16:00 is the only window where all 5 people are free at a valid start time: Yolanda [11:35-17:00], Isabella [13:10-17:00], Mary [13:35-17:00 with 10-min flexibility], Claire [8:00-16:00 in T after timezone adjustment], Zoey [13:40-18:00]. Claire's work hours (9-5 local = 8-4 in T) are the limiting factor. No other hour or half-hour start time on any day yields ≥120 min with all 5 available. Answer (120, 1) is correct. The harness is working as designed — single LLM call, correct output format, reasoning sound enough to reach the right conclusion.

No harness changes proposed by either candidate (both show diff = "no change"). Both decision documents (inv1.md and dom1.md) conclude no edits are justified. The variance in outputs is model stochasticity within an unchanged harness, not evidence of harness deficiency. The base run succeeded; the cost of speculative changes to a working system outweighs the benefit.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
